message:
Hello Everyone,

I have been away from home for a very long time. The reason that you'all have not heard from me is that in October 2007 I had a massive heart attack and had to have a tracheostomy and be placed on a ventilator for several months and I had to have physical therapy. I finally made it home on Nov. 21, 2008.

Upon being united with my computer I e-mailed the Secretary of the PSC where I have my formal complaint against T-Netix. I was told that the commission had not ruled on it as of yet. Imagine thats a total of 2 yrs.

I want everyone to go online and read the response of T-Netix through their attorneys. You can type in Elvera Williams vs T-Netix and it will come up. I want everyone out there to know that their response is full of lies.

I intend to challenge them on all of it . I have already contacted a lawyer about these lies.

It says that my husband contacted Verizon with them on the line and verified payment of the telephone bill. This is one big lie.
Will keep everyone informed of the outcome.

Bye for now.
Elvera
